purpose: Iterative runtime-native outdoor strategy game: multi-route PvP and 3 or 5 contested capture forts alongside the existing player citadels. No paid generation, Blender export or publishing.
runtimeSurface: Standalone Three.js HTML and Node private multiplayer

exceptions: Outdoor island navigation follows each existing map shoreline and relief; symmetric object meshes do not imply symmetric terrain.

circulation.description: Every route joins a traversable courtyard through a real open gate
circulation.captureFort: Actual open front courtyard; roads remain outside fortress footprint while armies enter capture radius.

scope: Runtime-native procedural code only. Room-export approval gates remain pending and are not claimed as passed.

captureForts.role: Territorial control and team income; ownership is communicated by flags, perimeter and readable UI.
captureForts.referenceArt: Existing matte citadel and game scene supplied by user; no generated image or external asset submission.
